scope: Small derived scalar review only. No PHX samples, full incident/mean-intensity arrays, model states, raw rate arrays or new public archive are included.

shared_field.definition: R=(<J_common>-<J_spherical_background>)/<J_spherical_line>. A receiver reconstructed as J_effective=J_common+J_spherical_line-J_spherical_background therefore has <J_effective>/<J_spherical_line>=1+R. Brackets are the selected line-profile quadrature. This is not the bare common-continuum/background ratio.
shared_field.continuum_geometry: Legacy slab for the common field; spherical finite chords for the three selected line groups.
limits: Finite line/group solves do not establish a common radiation field.
This supplied-state mismatch is a structural counterexample, not a converged thermal or observational error bound.

incident_input.native_probe_scope: Executed native boundary operator at the same three active IR frequencies and supplied spectrum. The minimal continuum probe lies entirely outside supplied coverage; it is not a new atmosphere or an observation test.
incident_input.reference_probe_scope: Executed C23 binary-search-only reference, same complete PHX TABLE SED and nuFnu normalization as the running qualification campaign. One-zone gas is only an input-field probe, not an atmospheric comparison.
limits: The same zero incident tail is confirmed in the native boundary operator and executed C23 input. This supports input parity only.
The matched 10000 K Planck tail is a hypothetical continuous completion, not measured stellar IR or the author configuration.
Nonzero hypothetical occupation does not demonstrate an atmospheric or observable error; physical adequacy remains unknown until paired complete roots are compared.
Author radiation settings and exact source reconstruction remain unknown.

provenance.inspection: The local raw outputs and source hashes were inspected; only derived scalars and their provenance hashes enter this review.
provenance.publication: The larger local experiments and original stellar data are not asserted to be public. No new archive or URL is created.
